context: A screenshot of ghent-live, a 3D map of the historic centre of Ghent (Belgium) centred on the Belfry, rendered in a web browser from the default camera, looking down at the centre from the south-west. A red ring on the ground marks the Belfry, and the buildings around it are drawn from the city's building footprints at their measured heights.

checks.name: dense_buildings
checks.instructions: Dense blocks of 3D buildings of varying heights fill the centre of the view.

checks.name: tower_at_ring
checks.instructions: A tall tower stands at the red ring on the ground, rising clearly above the buildings around it.

checks.name: one_building_highlighted
